title: Stop Using Hooks Like This — go viral by swapping tired power words for unique ones (ULTIMATE HACK vs MELT)
fmt: M-hook — hook-showcase (performed stale hooks + before/after power-word swaps)
segs: A-roll HOOK SLAM, night-office set: headline 'STOP USING HOOKS' (STOP USING in red, HOOKS in white) with a thin RED DECLINING CHART LINE drawn under the text
headline is the text; phrase chunks begin
hard cut at 0.0
voice only; onset candidates in grid

PHONE-IN-HAND POV: two hands hold a phone in a dark void; the phone plays DEVIN HIMSELF in a red-lit set performing the stale example hooks one by one — 'HERE'S MY ULTIMATE HACK' (green), a motion-blurred swipe, 'STEAL MY SECRET STRATEGY' (blue), 'HERE ARE 3 ILLEGAL WEBSITES' (magenta)
the hook headlines inside the phone are the text
hard cut into the phone; swipes inside are motion-blur transitions
voice over; the phone's own audio is not heard

PERFORMED EXAMPLE B-ROLL: Devin acts each stale hook inside the phone screen (red-lit second set), full-screen POV framing; ~5.5s; lands on 'here's my ultimate hack / steal my secret strategy / here are three illegal websites'; in = hard cut, out = blur-swipe to A-roll

A-roll: 'HOOK LIKE THIS' → an EYE/VIEW graphic flashes at his chest (numeral unreadable at 1fps) → 'BECAUSE' as a MOSAIC WALL of the same example-hook thumbnails builds up on the right/behind him ('EVERYONES HEARD THESE', 'A MILLION TIMES' tiles legible)
phrase chunks + the mosaic tiles carry their own hook text
hard cut
voice only

EMBEDDED EXAMPLE THUMBNAILS: his performed stale-hook frames repeated as a tiled wall; matrix/mosaic framing; ~10.5–12s tail of the segment; lands on 'everyone's heard these power words a million times'
GRAPHICS BEHIND HIM: the thumbnail mosaic fills the background behind/beside Devin while he stays foreground — a behind-presenter wall, not a frame replacement
A-roll: 'BUT INSTEAD' → 'BY JUST CHANGING (a couple words)'; TWO FAT-LOSS CREATOR CARDS fade in above his shoulders as he points up at them with both index fingers
phrase chunks; the two cards carry their hook text
cards fade/rise in on the gesture
voice only
Floating cards sit OVER the footage above his shoulders, timed to his two pointing fingers
EXAMPLE CARD 1 LARGE: a gym creator's video card 'Here are the 3 SECRETS to FAT LOSS' (SECRETS / FAT LOSS in green) with a 7K views badge; Devin is composited at lower-left, pointing UP at the card
card headline + 7K badge are the text
hard cut / card swap
voice over; the example's audio is not heard
EMBEDDED EXAMPLE REEL: another creator's fat-loss video as a large card, PiP-style composite with Devin pointing at it; ~5.5s; lands on '7,000 views — here are the three secrets to fat loss'
Card-over-footage composite: the example card takes most of the frame, Devin reduced to a pointing foreground figure

EXAMPLE CARD 2 LARGE: an outdoor creator's video card 'How To MELT Fat Off Your Body' (MELT in green) with a 1.2M views badge; Devin at lower-left pointing up; 'THIS IS EXACTLY WHAT YOU SHOULD DO (now)'
card headline + 1.2M badge are the text
card swap (motion-blur pass between cards)
voice over; the example's audio is not heard
EMBEDDED EXAMPLE REEL: the viral fat-loss video as a large card, PiP-style composite; ~4.5s; lands on '1.2 million views — if you want to melt off body fat this summer'
Card-over-footage composite, same construction as the 7K card — the pair is built to be compared

BOTH CARDS FLANK HIM, dimmed, as a backdrop pair; a 'POWER WORD' header (blue, in quotes) tops the frame; the MELT card gets a HANDWRITTEN annotation ('unique within its context') scrawled beside the highlighted word MELT while he explains
phrase chunks ('THE VIRAL VIDEO' / 'WHICH' / 'WHICH MADE IT STAND OUT' / 'WENT SO VIRAL') + handwriting annotation
hard cut
voice only
GRAPHICS BEHIND HIM: both example cards sit dimmed BEHIND Devin as the explanation backdrop; the annotation is drawn over the card, never over his face
SWAP 1, LIGHTING AS THE VERDICT: RED-LIT A-roll, air-quotes gesture, 'SUPER EASY' (SUPER in red) → the set light flips GREEN and the text becomes 'DISGUSTINGLY EASY' (DISGUSTINGLY in green)
word-swap chunks; colour of text matches the lighting
lighting flip is the transition (no cut)
voice only
PRACTICAL LIGHTING CHANGE is the background treatment: red wash = the stale word, green wash = the unique swap
SWAP 2, same device: RED-LIT 'SUPER SIMPLE' → GREEN-LIT 'MIND-NUMBINGLY SIMPLE' (MIND-NUMBINGLY in green); air quotes again on the stale version
word-swap chunks
lighting flip is the transition
voice only
PRACTICAL LIGHTING CHANGE, repeated — red/green is the segment's whole visual grammar

DOCUMENT DEVICE: a dark document card titled 'Viral Power Words' floats centre-frame over a BLURRED Devin; the doc scrolls through its power-word entries (small thumbnails at the right edge); at the bottom a COMMENT PILL types out the keyword ('U' → 'UNIQUE') with a send arrow
doc title + entries; the typing comment pill is the CTA text
hard cut (scene cut measured at 45.28)
voice over; typing sound unconfirmed (RMS-only)
GRAPHIC OVER A BLURRED BACKGROUND: Devin is defocused behind the floating document card — the only blurred-background beat in the reel
A-roll CLOSE: 'AND FOR THE LOVE OF GOD…' — the file CUTS OFF mid-sentence (the 'stop…' never lands). Cliffhanger ending, no end card
phrase chunk to the last frame
hard cut; hard end (deliberate cut-off)
voice cut mid-phrase class
